scope: Shipped Standard defaults. Pending entries are not permission approvals; new enablements require a recorded review.

conditions: Identifying User-Agent and cache
Display OpenStreetMap attribution; ODbL applies
Operator must deliberately choose this service and comply with its usage policy
Multiple processes or machines must coordinate their aggregate traffic
Use base_url to select a self-hosted or contracted search endpoint
Anonymous quota: 1000 requests per calendar month; upstream enforces the quota
API access permits commercial applications, but returned data has separate CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and third-party rights
Review attribution, sharing and commercial reuse of returned content separately
Content rights remain with the original authors
Check deployment volume and caching/republication rights; no unlimited quota is asserted
EMBL-EBI terms revised 2026-10-14
Service access grants no additional rights in third-party abstracts/full text
Check the specific source license before storing or redistributing; do not degrade service for others

wikipedia.authentication: No credentials sent by this search adapter
wikipedia.quota: Endpoint limits can change; obey delay and rate-reduction responses
wikipedia.retention_and_redistribution: Content-license conditions apply to cached and republished text; generally CC BY-SA 4.0 with project and imported-content exceptions
wikipedia.attribution: Source article URL, applicable license notice/link and modification notices; preserve additional imported-content credits
conditions: API policy version 1.0 dated 2024-08-26 allows conforming use without prior permission
Identifying User-Agent/contact, aggregate traffic limits and Retry-After handling need deployment verification
Scope is Wikimedia-hosted Wikipedia; custom base_url and generic mediawiki entries need separate reviews

wikipedia_entities.access_method: GET MediaWiki Action API; entity query variant
conditions: Same endpoint and conditions as the wikipedia record; count companion requests in aggregate traffic

wikipedia_any.access_method: GET MediaWiki Action API; any-word query variant
conditions: Same endpoint and conditions as the wikipedia record; count companion requests in aggregate traffic

wikidata.authentication: No credentials sent by this entity-search adapter
wikidata.quota: Wikimedia API usage limits; no unlimited request allowance
wikidata.retention_and_redistribution: Structured data in main, Property, Lexeme and EntitySchema namespaces is CC0; other namespace text is CC BY-SA 4.0
wikidata.attribution: Keep source entity URLs for provenance; do not extend CC0 to unrelated content
conditions: Scope covers wbsearchentities only; the separate SPARQL enrichment path needs its own endpoint review
Identifying User-Agent/contact and upstream throttling responses need deployment verification

stackexchange.authentication: Current adapter sends neither API key nor access_token
stackexchange.quota: IP/key-dependent daily quota; all callers of a method must respect its backoff field; avoid identical requests within one minute
stackexchange.retention_and_redistribution: Per-item content_license and revision history determine CC BY-SA version; API terms incorporate public-network terms
stackexchange.attribution: Identify Stack Exchange, preserve question and author links, and comply with the applicable content license
conditions: AUP requires prior written consent for automated collection used for AI/ML development, testing, indexing or benchmarking
Do not treat the API or content license as evidence of that consent
Current transport does not implement JSON method backoff; parser metadata alone does not complete display attribution

qiita.access_method: GET documented JSON API over TLS; optional Bearer token
qiita.authentication: Optional personal access token in api_key
qiita.quota: 60 requests/hour/IP without authentication; 1000/hour authenticated; response headers expose remaining quota
qiita.retention_and_redistribution: API availability does not establish a blanket license for publishing stored article bodies or snippets
qiita.attribution: Preserve source item and author; confirm the intended redistribution basis separately
conditions: Official help permits applications within the API's provided functions, prohibits advertising monetization of those apps and prohibits scraping
Plan total upstream requests across retries, caches and shared-IP users before enabling; no automatic quota accounting is implemented

marginalia.access_method: GET documented JSON API with API-Key header
marginalia.authentication: Explicit api_key required; public key is documented for integration development
marginalia.quota: The current API page does not publish a numeric quota for the public key and warns that it often reaches a rate limit
marginalia.retention_and_redistribution: Free and paid noncommercial keys use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; commercial key terms differ
marginalia.attribution: Preserve response license and Marginalia source identity; commercial keys are documented without an attribution requirement
conditions: API page updated 2025-12-08; do not silently select the public development key for production or benchmarks
Record the actual key plan and reuse rights; a custom endpoint does not inherit public-service terms

braveapi.access_method: GET documented JSON API with X-Subscription-Token header
braveapi.authentication: Operator API key and plan/order form required
braveapi.quota: Plan-dependent; no plan or quota was verified for this repository
braveapi.retention_and_redistribution: General terms permit transient operational storage only and restrict redistribution and AI evaluation/benchmarking; order forms are part of the agreement
braveapi.attribution: Preserve notices and source links; API access does not license underlying third-party pages
conditions: General terms updated 2026-09-01; verify the operator's specific storage/AI rights before persisting benchmark responses
Official FAQ describes plans with storage rights; product availability alone does not establish this operator's entitlement

wiby.authentication: No credentials in the documented JSON integration or shipped entry
wiby.quota: Not specified in the reviewed integration invitation
wiby.retention_and_redistribution: No blanket returned-content license identified; GPLv2 applies to Wiby's software
conditions: The About page expressly invites application integration through JSON output
This review covers only the wiby setting entry and endpoint, not every json_engine provider
